records.raw_text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Umar ibn al-Khattab, ؓ, who said While Umar was at Jam’ (Muzdalifah), a man came to him and said, "O Commander of the Faithful, I have just arrived while in the state of ihram for Hajj." Umar asked him, "Have you brought a sacrificial animal to Arafat?" The man replied, "No." So Umar sent a man with him and said, "Take him to Arafat and let him stand there, then hurry back to me, for I will detain the people for you." When morning came, Umar ibn al-Khattab, ؓ, stood with the people and began asking, "Has the man arrived?" They said, "No." He kept the people detained until the man arrived, then he proceeded, and the people proceeded with him.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from the Prophet, ﷺ, that a man arrived on the Day of Sacrifice while he was in the state of ihram for Hajj. He commanded him to enter the state of ihram for Umrah and made Hajj obligatory upon him for the following year.
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَدِمَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ وَهُوَ مُهِلٌّ بِالْحَجِّ، فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُهِلَّ بِالْعُمْرَةِ، وَجَعَلَ عَلَيْهِ الْحَجَّ مِنْ قَابِلٍ»

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Musa ibn Abi Kathir, from someone who narrated to him, from Ibn Umar, ؓ,  that he saw the people at the Jamrah proclaiming the talbiyah and takbir. He said, “That is it—yes, that is it—by the Lord of the Ka‘bah.” When he departed, he was asked about this, and he said, “It is the word of piety, and they are most entitled to it and worthy of it.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ ⦗ص: 120⦘ ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّهُ أَبْصَرَهُمْ عِنْدَ الْجَمْرَةِ يُهِلُّونَ وَيُكَبِّرُونَ قَالَ «هِيَ هِيَ هِيَ هِيَ وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ» . قَالَ: فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ سُئِلَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، قَالَ: «كَلِمَةُ التَّقْوَى، وَهُمْ أَحَقُّ بِهَا وَأَهْلُهَا»

records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Musa ibn Abi Kathir, from someone who narrated to him, from Ibn Umar, ؓ, that he saw them at the Jamrah raising their voices with talbiyah and takbir. He said , "It is it, it is it, it is it, it is it, by the Lord of the Ka'bah." When he departed, he was asked about that, and he said, "It is the word of piety, and they are most deserving of it and its people."

records.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Musa ibn Abi Kathir, from someone who narrated to him, from Ibn Umar, ؓ,

records.boundary_review_note: The isnad includes an unidentified transmitter between Musa ibn Abi Kathir and Ibn Umar; the matn includes Ibn Umar’s observation and later explanation.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim : “If a man passes the appointed miqat without entering ihram, he owes a dam (sacrificial offering), unless he returns to it.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا تَرَكَ الرَّجُلُ الْوَقْتَ، فَعَلَيْهِ دَمٌ إِلَّا أَنْ يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْهِ»

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that the Prophet, ﷺ, would perform *ramal* (brisk walking) in the first three circuits of the *tawaf* from the Black Stone back to it.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said I disapprove for the pilgrim in ihram to cover his mouth.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim  Safiyyah bint Huyayy, ؓ, to leave. She said, “I am menstruating.” He exclaimed in frustration, “You are going to hold us up now!” He then asked, “Had you not already performed the tawaf of the House on the Day of Sacrifice?” She said, “Yes.” He said, “Then depart.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتَ حُيَيٍّ رضي الله عنها أَنْ تَصْدُرَ، فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي حَائِضٌ. فَقَالَ: «عَقْرَى حَلْقَى، إِنَّكِ الْآنَ لَحَابِسَتُنَا» . ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ فَقَالَ: «أَمَا كُنْتِ طُفْتِ بِالْبَيْتِ طَوَافَ يَوْمِ النَّحْرِ» ؟ قَالَتْ: نَعَمْ. قَالَ: «فَاصْدُرِي»

records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim that the Prophet, ﷺ, ordered Safiyyah bint Huyayy, ؓ, to depart. She said , "I am menstruating." He said, "May you be hindered and distressed, are you now the one holding us back?" Then he mentioned and said, "Did you not perform the circumambulation of the House on the Day of Sacrifice?" She said, "Yes." He said, "Then depart."

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said There is no harm for a man or woman in ihram to use the tooth-stick, squeeze a boil, open a wound, set a fracture, bind splints, treat themselves with whatever they wish, and apply kohl with whatever they wish, provided there is no perfume in any of their medicines or kohl.
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ لِلْمُحْرِمِ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ أَنْ يَتَسَوَّكَ وَيَعْصِرَ الْقُرْحَةَ وَيَبُطَّ الْجَرْحَ، وَيَجْبُرَ الْكَسْرَ، وَيَرْبِطَ عَلَى الْجَبَائِرِ، وَيَتَدَاوَى بِمَا أَحَبَّ، وَيَكْتَحِلَ بِمَا أَحَبَّ بَعْدَ أَنْ لَا يَكُونَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ أَدْوِيَتِهِ وَأَكْحَالِهِ طِيبٌ»

records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ لِلْمُحْرِمِ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ أَنْ يَتَسَوَّكَ وَيَعْصِرَ الْقُرْحَةَ وَيَبُطَّ الْجَرْحَ، وَيَجْبُرَ الْكَسْرَ، وَيَرْبِطَ عَلَى الْجَبَائِرِ، وَيَتَدَاوَى بِمَا أَحَبَّ، وَيَكْتَحِلَ بِمَا أَحَبَّ بَعْدَ أَنْ لَا يَكُونَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ أَدْوِيَتِهِ وَأَكْحَالِهِ طِيبٌ»
records.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
records.matn_en: that he said There is no harm for a man or woman in ihram to use the tooth-stick, squeeze a boil, open a wound, set a fracture, bind splints, treat themselves with whatever they wish, and apply kohl with whatever they wish, provided there is no perfume in any of their medicines or kohl.
records.boundary_review_note: Ibrahim’s legal statement begins matn.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that if a pilgrim in ihram suffers harm to his body or head and treats it with medicine containing perfume or shaves his head, he may expiate with any of the expiations he wishes: if he wishes, he may fast three days; if he wishes, he may feed six poor persons, giving each poor person half a sa‘ of wheat; or if he wishes, he may slaughter a sheep and give its meat in charity. That is the saying of God the Exalted: “Then an expiation of fasting,” and this is that fast; “or charity,” and this is that charity; “or sacrifice,” and that is a sheep he slaughters and gives its meat in charity, so from this is the sacrifice.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abd al-Aziz ibn Rafi from Mujahid from Ibn Abbas, ؓ,  that a man came to him and said, “I kissed my wife while I was in ihram, and I ejaculated from desire.” Ibn Abbas said, “You are indeed sexually driven. Offer a sacrificial animal, and your Hajj is complete.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رَفِيعٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما قَالَ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي قَبَّلْتُ امْرَأَتِي وَأَنَا مُحْرِمٌ فَحَذَفْتُ بِشَهْوَتِي، قَالَ: «إِنَّكَ لَشَبِقٌ، أَهْرِقْ دَمًا، وَتَمَّ حَجُّكَ»

records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abd al-Aziz ibn Rafi from Mujahid from Ibn Abbas, ؓ, who said A man came to him and said, "I kissed my wife while I was in ihram and emitted with desire." He said, "You are indeed lustful. Shed blood (offer a sacrifice), and your Hajj is complete."

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim who said The pilgrim in ihram may bathe, pour water over his head, and do so gently.
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ «يَغْتَسِلُ الْمُحْرِمُ وَيَصُبُّ الْمَاءَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَيَرْفُقُ بِهِ»

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah and Al-Aswad,  from Alqamah and al-Aswad, who said: “We departed from Arafat with Umar, ؓ. As he set out, we heard him say, ‘People, remain calm. Righteousness does not consist in driving camels swiftly.’ His camel kept chewing its cud until we reached Jam‘ (Muzdalifah).”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، وَالْأَسْوَدِ، أَنَّهُمَا أَفَاضَا مَعَ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهم جَمِيعًا، فَسَمِعْنَاهُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ حِينَ أَفَاضَ: أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ «عَلَيْكُمْ بِالسَّكِينَةِ؛ فَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ لَيْسَ فِي إِيضَاعِ الْإِبِلِ، وَإِنَّ بَعِيرَهُ لَمْ يَزَلْ يَقْصَعُ بِجَرَّتِهِ حَتَّى نَزَلْنَا جَمْعًا»
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، وَالْأَسْوَدِ، أَنَّهُمَا أَفَاضَا مَعَ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهم جَمِيعًا، فَسَمِعْنَاهُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ حِينَ أَفَاضَ: أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ «عَلَيْكُمْ بِالسَّكِينَةِ؛ فَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ لَيْسَ فِي إِيضَاعِ الْإِبِلِ، وَإِنَّ بَعِيرَهُ لَمْ يَزَلْ يَقْصَعُ بِجَرَّتِهِ حَتَّى نَزَلْنَا جَمْعًا»
records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah and Al-Aswad, that they performed the ritual circling of the Kaaba with Umar, ؓ all. We heard him say when he began the circling: "O people, maintain tranquility, for righteousness is not in the swiftness of camels. His camel continued to move steadily with its reins until we descended at Jam."

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said The pilgrim in ihram may anoint cracks with clarified butter and fat.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Sa'id ibn Jubayr that he said "Treat the cracks [of your skin] with whatever you eat."

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Mujahid, who said I asked Ibn Umar, ؓ, "Should the pilgrim in ihram wash his clothes?" He said, "Yes, for God does not care about his filth."

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Nafi’, from Ibn Umar, ؓ, that he set out until he was two miles or two farsakhs from Medina while in the state of ihram for Umrah, then he entered ihram for Hajj.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said regarding the pilgrim in ihram who has sores and treats them with perfume, then other sores appear before the first heal and he treats them: "He may choose whichever of the expiations he wishes; it is one expiation."

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from someone who narrated to him, from Ata ibn Abi Rabah, : “For visitors from outside Mecca, tawaf is dearer to me than prayer.”

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham that a man came to the Prophet, ﷺ, and said , "My father was an elderly man and could not perform Hajj until he died. Shall I perform Hajj on his behalf?" He said, "If your father had a debt and you paid it off, would it not suffice for him?"
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ أَبِي كَانَ شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا، فَلَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَحُجَّ حَتَّى مَاتَ، أَفَأَحُجُّ عَنْهُ؟ قَالَ: «أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ كَانَ عَلَى أَبِيكَ دَيْنٌ فَقَضَيْتَهُ أَمَا كَانَ يُجْزِئُ عَنْهُ»

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Ja'far ibn Muhammad from Sa'id ibn Jubayr from Ibn Umar, ؓ, who said A man came to him and said, "I have completed all the rites of Hajj except the Tawaf around the House, then I had relations with my wife." He said, "Complete what remains for you, offer a sacrifice, and you must perform Hajj again next year." The man returned to him and said, "I have come from a distant land." So he replied to him as he had before.
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما قَالَ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي قَضَيْتُ الْمَنَاسِكَ ⦗ص: 125⦘ كُلَّهَا غَيْرَ الطَّوَافِ بِالْبَيْتِ، ثُمَّ وَاقَعْتُ أَهْلِي، قَالَ: «فَاقْضِ مَا بَقِيَ عَلَيْكَ وَأَهْرِقْ دَمًا، وَعَلَيْكَ الْحَجُّ مِنْ قَابِلٍ» ، قَالَ: فَعَادَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي جِئْتُ مِنْ شُقَّةٍ بَعِيدَةٍ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ لَهُ مِثْلَ قَوْلِهِ

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that he said regarding the prayer at Arafat: "If one volunteers to pray between them, he should pray each one with a call to prayer (adhan) and a commencement (iqamah). If he does not volunteer between them, he should pray them both with one call to prayer and two commencements."

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said Whoever among the men omits the farewell circumambulation must offer a blood sacrifice, but whoever among the women omits it owes nothing.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ibn Umar, ؓ, that he became thirsty while performing Tawaf, so he turned toward Zamzam, drank from it, and poured some over his face.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah, ؓ, that Suraqah ibn Malik ibn Ju'shum said O Messenger of God, is this Umrah of ours for this year only or forever? He said: "Forever."
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ ⦗ص: 126⦘ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّ سُرَاقَةَ بْنَ مَالِكِ بْنِ جُعْشُمٍ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَرَأَيْتَ عُمْرَتَنَا هَذِهِ لِعَامِنَا أَمْ لِلْأَبَدِ؟ قَالَ: «لِلْأَبَدِ»

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, ؓ, that Suraqah ibn Malik, ؓ, said: “We have been told about this religion of ours as though we had only just been created for it. Are we to act in matters already decreed and written down, or in matters yet to come?” The Prophet replied, “Rather, act in matters already decreed and written down.” Suraqah asked, “Then what is the point of acting, Messenger of God?” He said, “Act, for each person is facilitated toward what he was created for.” Then he recited the verse: “As for the one who gives, is mindful of God, and affirms the best [reward] …” through the end of the verse.
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ رضي الله عنه: أَنَّ سُرَاقَةَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ رضي الله عنه قَالَ فَحُدِّثْنَا عَنْ دِينِنَا هَذَا كَأَنَّا خُلِقْنَا لَهُ السَّاعَةَ نَعْمَلُ لِشَيْءٍ قَدْ جَرَتْ بِهِ الْمَقَادِيرُ وَجَفَّتْ بِهِ الْأَقْلَامُ أَمْ لِشَيْءٍ يُسْتَقْبَلُ؟ قَالَ: «بَلْ لِشَيْءٍ قَدْ جَرَتْ بِهِ الْمَقَادِيرُ، وَجَفَّتْ بِهِ الْأَقْلَامُ» ، قَالَ: فَفِيمَ الْعَمَلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «اعْمَلُوا فَكُلٌّ مُيَسَّرٌ لِمَا خُلِقَ» ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ قَرَأَ الْآيَةَ {فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَى وَاتَّقَى وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَى} [الليل: 6] إِلَى آخِرِ الْآيَةِ

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, that he sent Alqamah with an offering and said "Slaughter it, eat a third, give a third in charity, and send a third to the family of Utbah ibn Mas'ud."

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Asim ibn Kulayb, from Abu Burdah, from Abu Musa, ؓ, that the Prophet, ﷺ, visited some people who slaughtered a sheep for him. He put a morsel of its meat in his mouth but could not swallow it. He asked, “What is the matter with this meat?” They replied, “It is so-and-so’s sheep. We slaughtered it before he arrived, intending to compensate him with one of his sheep.” The Prophet, ﷺ, said, “Give it to the captives”—meaning the poor.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Musa ibn Abi Kathir from Amir that he said regarding a man who has intercourse with his wife’s mother: "His wife does not become unlawful to him; what is unlawful does not render what is lawful unlawful."
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِيمَنْ يُجَامِعُ أُمَّ امْرَأَتِهِ: «لَا تُحَرَّمُ عَلَيْهِ امْرَأَتُهُ؛ لَا يُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْهِ الْحَرَامُ الْحَلَالَ»

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Mujahid, who said Satan fears you just as you fear him. So when you see him, do not be afraid of him, lest he overpower you. Instead, stand firm against him, for he will flee.

records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَتَّقِيكُمْ كَمَا تَتَّقُونَهُ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمُوهُ فَلَا تَهَابُوهُ فَيَرْكَبَكُمْ، وَلَكِنْ شُدُّوا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّهُ يَهْرَبُ»

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah, from the one who reported to him, from al-Hasan al-Basri, that he said "The family of Muhammad, ﷺ, are the community of Muhammad, ﷺ."
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ الْبَصْرِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ «آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُمَّةُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم»

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said If the mother of a child (concubine) commits adultery, she is not to be sold under any circumstances.
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ «إِذَا زَنَتْ أُمُّ الْوَلَدِ فَلَا تُبَاعُ عَلَى حَالٍ»
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ «إِذَا زَنَتْ أُمُّ الْوَلَدِ فَلَا تُبَاعُ عَلَى حَالٍ»

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from some of his companions that Gabriel came to the Prophet, ﷺ, and wrapped him in a black turban, letting its end hang down behind him.
records.text_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ بَعْضِ، أَصْحَابِهِ: «أَنَّ جِبْرِيلَ، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَمَّمَهُ بِعِمَامَةٍ سَوْدَاءٍ، وَأَسْدَلَ لَهَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِ»
records.raw_text_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ بَعْضِ، أَصْحَابِهِ: «أَنَّ جِبْرِيلَ، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَمَّمَهُ بِعِمَامَةٍ سَوْدَاءٍ، وَأَسْدَلَ لَهَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِ»

records.matn_ar: أَنَّ جِبْرِيلَ، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَمَّمَهُ بِعِمَامَةٍ سَوْدَاءٍ، وَأَسْدَلَ لَهَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِ»

records.boundary_review_note: Abu Hanifah’s unnamed companions are the final explicit transmitters; the following text reports Gabriel’s visit to the Prophet.

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated to us, saying: Abu Hanifah narrated to us from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that Ibn Umar, ؓ, divorced his wife while she was menstruating. This was criticized, so he took her back and then divorced her while she was in a state of purity.
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو يُوسُفَ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما «طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ فِي حَيْضِهَا، فَعِيبَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ فَرَاجَعَهَا وَطَلَّقَهَا فِي طُهْرِهَا»
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو يُوسُفَ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما «طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ فِي حَيْضِهَا، فَعِيبَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ فَرَاجَعَهَا وَطَلَّقَهَا فِي طُهْرِهَا»

records.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما «طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ فِي حَيْضِهَا، فَعِيبَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ فَرَاجَعَهَا وَطَلَّقَهَا فِي طُهْرِهَا»

records.boundary_review_note: This report has an explicitly different outer transmission route through Abu Yusuf; the matn begins with Ibn Umar’s account.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said There is nothing among what God has made lawful that is more hateful to God than divorce.
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَيْسَ شَيْءٌ مِمَّا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ أَبْغَضُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الطَّلَاقِ»

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Habib ibn Abi Thabit from Ibn Abbas, ؓ, that he said "A pregnant woman whose husband has died is to be provided for from her share."

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said "Every separation initiated by the woman is not a divorce, and every separation initiated by the husband is a divorce."
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ «كُلُّ فُرْقَةٍ كَانَتْ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْمَرْأَةِ فَلَيْسَ بِطَلَاقٍ، وَكُلُّ فُرْقَةٍ كَانَتْ مِنْ قِبَلِ الزَّوْجِ فَهُوَ طَلَاقٌ»

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim: Abu Kanaf divorced his wife and informed her, then took her back before her waiting period ended without telling her. Later he returned and found that she had married another man. He went to Umar ibn al-Khattab, ؓ, and told him what had happened. Umar said, “If you find that the new husband has not consummated the marriage with her, you have the greater claim to her; but if he has, you have no claim to her.” Abu Kanaf returned and found that she had styled the forelock of her hair. He said, “I have something to attend to; leave me alone.” They did so, and he spent the night with her. In the morning he went to the governor with Umar’s letter. They recognized that he had come with a sound ruling.
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: أَنَّ أَبَا كَنَفٍ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَأَعْلَمَهَا، وَرَاجَعَهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْقَضِيَ عِدَّتُهَا وَلَمْ يُعْلِمْهَا، فَجَاءَ وَقَدْ تَزَوَّجْتِ الْمَرْأَةُ فَأَتَى عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، فَقَصَّ عَلَيْهِ الْخَبَرَ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: «إِنْ وَجَدْتَهُ لَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا فَأَنْتَ أَحَقُّ بِهَا وَإِنْ كَانَ قَدْ دَخَلَ بِهَا فَلَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهَا سَبِيلٌ» . فَقَدِمَ وَقَدْ وَضَعَتِ الْقُصَّةَ عَلَى رَأْسِهَا، فَقَالَ: إِنَّ لِي حَاجَةً فَأَخْلُونِي، فَفَعَلُوا، فَوَقَعَ عَلَيْهَا وَبَاتَ عِنْدَهَا، ثُمَّ غَدَا إِلَى الْأَمِيرِ بِكِتَابِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، فَعَرَفُوا أَنَّهُ قَدْ جَاءَ بِأَمْرٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ

records.raw_text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim: Abu Kanaf divorced his wife and informed her, then he took her back before her waiting period ended without informing her. Later, he came and found that the woman had already remarried. So he went to Umar ibn al-Khattab, ؓ, and told him the story. Umar said "If you find that he has not consummated the marriage with her, then you have more right to her. But if he has consummated the marriage with her, then you have no claim over her." He then returned and found that she had given birth, having carried the matter to term. He said: "I have a need, so leave me alone." They did so, and he had relations with her and spent the night with her. The next morning, he went to the governor with the letter of Umar ibn al-Khattab, ؓ. They recognized that he had come with a correct ruling.

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ali ibn Abi Talib, ؓ, that he said: “If a man gives his wife one revocable divorce, then has witnesses attest that he has taken her back before her waiting period ends, but she does not know of the revocation and marries another man who consummates the marriage with her, she must be separated from the second husband and returned to the first. She is entitled to a dowry from the second husband for the intercourse he had with her.”

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim, who said A slave may not take a concubine. Do you not see the saying of God the Exalted: "Those who guard their private parts except from their wives or what their right hands possess" until the end of the verse? A slave does not own anything.

records.matn_en: that he said A slave may not marry more than two women.
records.boundary_review_note: Ibrahim’s statement begins matn.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that he asked Alqamah about a man who committed adultery with a woman and then married her. He recited this verse: *And it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds.* (Ash-Shura: 25)
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، «أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ فَجَرَ بِامْرَأَةٍ ثُمَّ تَزَوَّجَهَا، فَقَرَأَ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ» {وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَعْفُو عَنِ السَّيِّئَاتِ} [الشورى: 25] "

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, ؓ, that he said regarding that: "Its beginning is fornication, and its end is marriage."
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي ذَلِكَ: «أَوَّلُهُ سِفَاحٌ وَآخِرُهُ نِكَاحٌ»
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي ذَلِكَ: «أَوَّلُهُ سِفَاحٌ وَآخِرُهُ نِكَاحٌ»

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said: “If a man says to his wife, before consummating the marriage, ‘You are divorced’ three times, she is irrevocably separated by the first divorce; the other two do not take effect because he no longer has a marriage to dissolve. If he pronounces three divorces at once, she is forbidden to him until she marries another husband.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ " إِذَا قَالَ الرَّجُلُ لِامْرَأَتِهِ وَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا: أَنْتِ طَالِقٌ، أَنْتِ طَالِقٌ، أَنْتِ طَالِقٌ: بَانَتِ الْأُولَى، وَكَانَتِ الثِّنْتَانِ فِيمَا لَا يَمْلِكُ، وَإِذَا طَلَّقَهَا ثَلَاثًا جَمَاعَةً فَهِيَ عَلَيْهِ حَرَامٌ حَتَّى تَنْكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ "
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ " إِذَا قَالَ الرَّجُلُ لِامْرَأَتِهِ وَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا: أَنْتِ طَالِقٌ، أَنْتِ طَالِقٌ، أَنْتِ طَالِقٌ: بَانَتِ الْأُولَى، وَكَانَتِ الثِّنْتَانِ فِيمَا لَا يَمْلِكُ، وَإِذَا طَلَّقَهَا ثَلَاثًا جَمَاعَةً فَهِيَ عَلَيْهِ حَرَامٌ حَتَّى تَنْكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ "
records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said When a man says to his wife whom he has not consummated the marriage with, "You are divorced, you are divorced, you are divorced," the first divorce takes effect, and the other two are in what he does not possess. If he divorces her with three divorces at once, she becomes unlawful to him until she marries another husband.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ali, ؓ, that he said regarding a woman whose husband is announced dead to her, then she marries, and afterward her first husband returns: "She is to be returned to her first husband, and he may not approach her until her waiting period from the other man has ended. She is to be separated from the other man, and she is entitled to the dowry from him for what he lawfully enjoyed of her. The first husband may not approach her until her waiting period from the other man has ended."
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ يُنْعَى إِلَيْهَا زَوْجُهَا فَتَتَزَوَّجُ ثُمَّ يَقْدُمُ: «أَنَّهَا تُرَدُّ إِلَى زَوْجِهَا الْأَوَّلِ، وَلَا يَقْرَبُهَا حَتَّى تَنْقَضِيَ عِدَّتُهَا مِنَ الْآخَرِ، وَيُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ الْآخَرِ، وَلَهَا الْمَهْرُ مِنْهُ بِمَا اسْتَحَلَّ مِنْ فَرْجِهَا، وَلَا يَقْرَبُهَا الْأَوَّلُ حَتَّى تَنْقَضِيَ عِدَّتُهَا مِنَ ⦗ص: 132⦘ الْآخَرِ»
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ يُنْعَى إِلَيْهَا زَوْجُهَا فَتَتَزَوَّجُ ثُمَّ يَقْدُمُ: «أَنَّهَا تُرَدُّ إِلَى زَوْجِهَا الْأَوَّلِ، وَلَا يَقْرَبُهَا حَتَّى تَنْقَضِيَ عِدَّتُهَا مِنَ الْآخَرِ، وَيُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ الْآخَرِ، وَلَهَا الْمَهْرُ مِنْهُ بِمَا اسْتَحَلَّ مِنْ فَرْجِهَا، وَلَا يَقْرَبُهَا الْأَوَّلُ حَتَّى تَنْقَضِيَ عِدَّتُهَا مِنَ ⦗ص: 132⦘ الْآخَرِ»

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that a man asked Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, about a man who dies leaving a wife with whom he had not consummated the marriage and had not specified her dowry. He said I have not heard anything from the Prophet, ﷺ, regarding this. It was said to him: Then give your opinion on it. He said: I see that she should receive the full dowry of her peers, the full inheritance, and she must observe the waiting period. A man from Ashja' then said: You have judged in this matter, by the One by whom oaths are taken, with the same judgment as the Prophet, ﷺ, gave in the case of Barwa' bint Washiq al-Ashja'iyyah.

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that Umar, ؓ, used to grant the thrice-divorced woman both lodging and maintenance. Fatimah bint Qays said "My husband divorced me thrice, and the Messenger of God, ﷺ, did not grant me lodging or maintenance." records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim: A man gave his wife one divorce. She menstruated twice. When she entered her third menstrual period and the bleeding stopped, she went to bathe, brought her water close, and removed her clothes. Before she poured the water over herself, he came and took her back. She went to Umar ibn al-Khattab, ؓ, and told him what had happened. Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ, was present, and Umar asked him for his opinion. Ibn Mas‘ud said, “I consider her still his wife, because prayer is not permitted to her while she menstruates until it becomes permitted to her again.” Umar said, “I hold the same view.” He returned her to her husband and said of Abdullah, “He is a storehouse filled with knowledge.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: أَنَّ رَجُلًا طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَاحِدَةً، فَحَاضَتْ حَيْضَتَيْنِ، حَتَّى إِذَا دَخَلَتْ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ وَانْقَطَعَ الدَّمُ، وَدَخَلَتْ فِي مُغْتَسَلِهَا وَأَدْنَتْ مَاءَهَا، وَوَضَعَتْ ثَوْبَهَا أَتَاهَا فَرَاجَعَهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُفِيضَ عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ، فَأَتَتْ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، وَعِنْدَهُ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه، فَقَالَ لَهُ: قُلْ فِيهَا، قَالَ: «أَرَاهَا امْرَأَتَهُ؛ لِأَنَّهَا لَمْ تَحِلْ لَهَا الصَّلَاةُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ حَتَّى تَحِلَّ لَهَا الصَّلَاةُ» ، قَالَ: وَأَنَا أَرَى ذَلِكَ، فَرَدَّهَا عَلَى زَوْجِهَا وَقَالَ: لَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ: كَنِيفٌ مَمْلُوءٌ عِلْمًا

records.raw_text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim: A man divorced his wife with a single divorce. She then menstruated twice, and when she entered her third cycle and the blood ceased, she entered her place of bathing, prepared her water, and removed her clothes. Her husband came to her and took her back before she poured the water over herself. She then went to Umar ibn al-Khattab, ؓ, and mentioned this to him. Ibn Mas'ud said, "I consider her still his wife, for she has not yet become pure for prayer while menstruating until she becomes pure for prayer." Umar said, "I also hold this view," and he returned her to her husband. Then he said to Abdullah, "A vessel filled with knowledge."

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim: A Bedouin’s wife gave birth, but her child died. Her breast milk became abundant, and she said to her husband, “Suckle some of it, then spit it out.” He did so, and some milk went down his throat. He went to Abu Musa, ؓ, and asked him about it. Abu Musa said, “Your wife is now forbidden to you.” The man then went to Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ, and asked him, telling him what Abu Musa had said. Ibn Mas‘ud replied, “You were only treating her. There is no nursing after weaning; only nursing that produces flesh and bone makes marriage unlawful. Keep your wife.” The man returned to Abu Musa and told him Abdullah’s ruling. Abu Musa said, “Do not ask me while this scholar is among you.”

records.boundary_review_note: The report of a woman’s question to Hafsah and the Prophet’s response begins matn.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said: “If a woman offers herself to a man in marriage before witnesses and he accepts her, this constitutes a marriage. She is entitled to a dowry equivalent to that of women of her standing, unless she agrees to less. If he does not accept her, nothing is due. If he accepts her without witnesses, the two must be separated and she must observe the waiting period. She is not entitled to a dowry if he has not consummated the marriage; if he has, she must observe the waiting period and is entitled to the dowry.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ «إِذَا وَهَبَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ نَفْسَهَا لِلرَّجُلِ بِشُهُودٍ، فَقَبِلَهَا الرَّجُلُ، فَهُوَ نِكَاحٌ، وَلَهَا مَهْرُ مِثْلِهَا، إِلَّا أَنْ تَرْضَى بِأَقَلَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَقْبَلْهَا فَلَا شَيْءَ، وَإِنْ قَبِلَهَا وَلَمْ تَكُنْ شُهُودٌ فُرِّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا، وَالْعِدَّةُ عَلَيْهَا، وَلَا صَدَاقَ لَهَا إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ دَخَلَ بِهَا، فَإِنْ كَانَ دَخَلَ بِهَا فَعَلَيْهَا الْعِدَّةُ وَلَهَا الصَّدَاقُ»

records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said If a woman offers herself in marriage to a man in the presence of witnesses, and the man accepts her, then it is a valid marriage, and she is entitled to a dowry equal to that of her peers, unless she agrees to less. If he does not accept her, then there is nothing binding. If he accepts her but there are no witnesses, they must be separated, and she must observe the waiting period. She is not entitled to a dowry if he has not consummated the marriage. If he has consummated the marriage, then she must observe the waiting period, and she is entitled to the dowry.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said concerning a man who divorces his wife three times during his final illness: “She inherits from him as long as she is in her waiting period. When that period ends, she does not inherit. If he divorces her during his illness before consummating the marriage, she is entitled to half the dowry, has no waiting period, and does not inherit.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ يُطَلِّقُ امْرَأَتَهُ ثَلَاثًا فِي مَرَضِهِ: «أَنَّهَا تَرِثُهُ مَا كَانَتْ فِي عِدَّتِهَا، فَإِذَا انْقَضَتِ الْعِدَّةُ لَمْ تَرِثْ، وَإِنْ طَلَّقَهَا فِي مَرَضِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ بِهَا فَلَهَا نِصْفُ الْمَهْرِ، وَلَا عِدَّةَ عَلَيْهَا، وَلَا مِيرَاثَ لَهَا»

records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said regarding the man who divorces his wife three times during his illness: She inherits from him as long as she is in her waiting period. Once the waiting period ends, she does not inherit. If he divorces her during his illness before consummating the marriage, she is entitled to half the dowry, has no waiting period, and does not inherit.

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abdul-Malik ibn Abi Sulayman, from Ata ibn Abi Rabah, concerning emancipation, the same ruling applies.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Bakr, from al-Hasan and Ibn Sirin, who both said: “The divorce takes effect, and the attempted exception is invalid.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، وَابْنِ سِيرِينَ أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا «يَقَعُ الطَّلَاقُ وَاسْتِثْنَاؤُهُ بَاطِلٌ»
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، وَابْنِ سِيرِينَ أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا «يَقَعُ الطَّلَاقُ وَاسْتِثْنَاؤُهُ بَاطِلٌ»
records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Bakr from al-Hasan and Ibn Sirin that they both said "Divorce takes effect, and its exception is invalid."

records.matn_en: “The divorce takes effect, and the attempted exception is invalid.”

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Ibrahim and Amir, from al-Aswad, to whom a woman was mentioned. He said, “If I marry her, she is divorced.” He consulted the people of the Hijaz and others, and they said, “That has no effect.” Then he met Ibn Masʿud, ؓ, who said, “Tell her that she has authority over her own decision.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَامِرٍ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ: أَنَّهُ ذُكِرَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَةٌ فَقَالَ إِنْ تَزَوَّجْتَهَا فَهِيَ طَالِقٌ، فَسَأَلَ أَهْلَ الْحِجَازِ وَالنَّاسِ؟ فَقَالُوا: لَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ، فَلَقِيَ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه فَقَالَ: «أَخْبِرْهَا أَنَّهَا أَمْلَكُ بِنَفْسِهَا»

records.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Ibrahim and Amir, from al-Aswad, to whom a woman was mentioned.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Isma'il ibn Umayyah, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id, from Ibn Umar, ؓ, who said: “A female slave may not be approached sexually unless she is one whom her owner may lawfully sell, give away in charity, emancipate, or give as a gift.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا يُوطَأُ فَرْجُ شَيْءٍ مِنَ الْمَمْلُوكَاتِ إِلَّا فَرْجٌ إِنْ بَاعَهُ جَازَ، وَإِنْ تَصَدَّقَ بِهِ جَازَ، وَإِنْ أَعْتَقَهَا جَازَ، وَإِنْ وَهَبَهَا جَازَ»
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا يُوطَأُ فَرْجُ شَيْءٍ مِنَ الْمَمْلُوكَاتِ إِلَّا فَرْجٌ إِنْ بَاعَهُ جَازَ، وَإِنْ تَصَدَّقَ بِهِ جَازَ، وَإِنْ أَعْتَقَهَا جَازَ، وَإِنْ وَهَبَهَا جَازَ»
records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Isma'il ibn Umayyah, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id, from Ibn Umar, ؓ, that he said No private part of any slave woman may be lawfully approached except that of one whose sale is permitted, whose charity is permitted, whose emancipation is permitted, and whose gifting is permitted.
records.display_text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا يُوطَأُ فَرْجُ شَيْءٍ مِنَ الْمَمْلُوكَاتِ إِلَّا فَرْجٌ إِنْ بَاعَهُ جَازَ، وَإِنْ تَصَدَّقَ بِهِ جَازَ، وَإِنْ أَعْتَقَهَا جَازَ، وَإِنْ وَهَبَهَا جَازَ»
records.display_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Isma'il ibn Umayyah, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id, from Ibn Umar, ؓ, who said: “A female slave may not be approached sexually unless she is one whom her owner may lawfully sell, give away in charity, emancipate, or give as a gift.”
records.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا يُوطَأُ فَرْجُ شَيْءٍ مِنَ الْمَمْلُوكَاتِ إِلَّا فَرْجٌ إِنْ بَاعَهُ جَازَ، وَإِنْ تَصَدَّقَ بِهِ جَازَ، وَإِنْ أَعْتَقَهَا جَازَ، وَإِنْ وَهَبَهَا جَازَ»

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Ibn Umar, ؓ, who had two slave women whom he emancipated to take effect upon his death, and he used to have intercourse with them.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim who said: “Any separation initiated by the man is a divorce, and the woman is entitled to half the dowry even if the marriage has not been consummated. Any separation initiated by the woman entitles her to nothing if the marriage has not been consummated.”

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father. His father said: Abu Hanifah narrated to us from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said: “If a man divorces his wife once or twice, then another man marries her and consummates the marriage, and the first husband separates from her, then the first husband marries her again, she is then subject to a fresh count of three divorces with him; the intervening husband extinguishes the earlier one or two divorces. If the other husband did not consummate the marriage, she remains with the first husband with whatever number of divorces remained.”

records.raw_text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father who said Abu Hanifah narrated to us from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said: When a man divorces his wife once or twice, then another man marries her and consummates the marriage, and the first husband separates from her, then the first husband marries her again, she is with him on a new count of three divorces, and the one or two previous divorces are annulled. If the second husband did not consummate the marriage with her, then she remains with the first husband on whatever remains of the divorce count.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said: “If a man says to his wife, ‘You are divorced, if God wills,’ that has no effect, and the divorce does not take effect.”

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Qasim ibn Abd al-Rahman, from his father, from Ibn Masʿud, ؓ, who said in the marriage sermon: “All praise belongs to God. We praise Him, seek His help and forgiveness, and seek refuge in God from the evil within ourselves. Whoever God guides, no one can lead astray; and whoever He leaves astray, no one can guide. I bear witness that there is no god but God, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. ‘Fear God, through whom you ask one another, and honor the ties of kinship. Surely God is ever watchful over you.’ [Qur’an 4:1] ‘Fear God as He ought to be feared, and do not die except as Muslims.’ [Qur’an 3:102] ‘O you who believe, fear God and speak words of integrity’—through His words, ‘then he has achieved a great triumph.’ [Qur’an 33:70–71] Then he would say: ‘To proceed,’ and then mention his purpose.”

records.raw_text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Qasim ibn Abd al-Rahman, from his father, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, that he said in the marriage sermon: "All praise is due to God; we praise Him, seek His help, and ask His forgiveness. We seek refuge in God from the evils of our souls. Whomever God guides, none can lead astray, and whomever He leaves astray, none can guide. I bear witness that there is no god but God, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. *And fear God, through Whom you demand your mutual rights, and do not cut the relations of the wombs. Surely, God is ever Watchful over you.* [An-Nisa: 1] *Fear God as He should be feared, and do not die except as Muslims.* [Al Imran: 102] *O you who believe, fear God and speak words of appropriate justice.* [Al-Ahzab: 70] until His saying: *He has indeed succeeded with a great success.* [Al-Ahzab: 71] Then he said: 'As to what follows,' and then he would mention his need."

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ali, ؓ, who said regarding the “choose” option: “If she chooses her husband, it is one revocable divorce; if she chooses herself, it is one irrevocable divorce.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي اخْتَارِي: «إِنِ اخْتَارَتْ زَوْجَهَا فَوَاحِدَةٌ يَمْلِكُ الرَّجْعَةَ، وَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا فَوَاحِدَةٌ بَائِنَةٌ»
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي اخْتَارِي: «إِنِ اخْتَارَتْ زَوْجَهَا فَوَاحِدَةٌ يَمْلِكُ الرَّجْعَةَ، وَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا فَوَاحِدَةٌ بَائِنَةٌ»
records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that Ali, ؓ, said regarding the *ikhtiyar* (option of choice): "If she chooses her husband, it is a revocable divorce. If she chooses herself, it is an irrevocable divorce."
records.display_text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي اخْتَارِي: «إِنِ اخْتَارَتْ زَوْجَهَا فَوَاحِدَةٌ يَمْلِكُ الرَّجْعَةَ، وَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا فَوَاحِدَةٌ بَائِنَةٌ»
records.display_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ali, ؓ, who said regarding the “choose” option: “If she chooses her husband, it is one revocable divorce; if she chooses herself, it is one irrevocable divorce.”
records.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي اخْتَارِي: «إِنِ اخْتَارَتْ زَوْجَهَا فَوَاحِدَةٌ يَمْلِكُ الرَّجْعَةَ، وَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا فَوَاحِدَةٌ بَائِنَةٌ»
records.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ali, ؓ, who said regarding the “choose” option:
records.matn_en: “If she chooses her husband, it is one revocable divorce; if she chooses herself, it is one irrevocable divorce.”
records.boundary_review_note: Ali’s ruling on ikhtiyār begins matn.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Umar ibn al-Khattab and Ibn Masʿud, ؓ, who said regarding the wife’s option to choose: “If she chooses her husband, she remains his wife; if she chooses herself, it is one divorce, and he retains authority over her.” Zayd ibn Thabit, ؓ, said of her: “If she chooses her husband, she remains his wife; if she chooses herself, it is three divorces.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، وَابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا فِي اخْتَارِي: «إِنِ اخْتَارَتْ زَوْجَهَا فَهِيَ امْرَأَتُهُ، وَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا فَوَاحِدَةٌ وَهُوَ أَمْلَكُ بِهَا» وَإِنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ رضي الله عنه قَالَ فِيهَا: «إِنِ اخْتَارَتْ زَوْجَهَا فَهِيَ امْرَأَتُهُ، وَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا فَهِيَ ثَلَاثٌ»
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، وَابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا فِي اخْتَارِي: «إِنِ اخْتَارَتْ زَوْجَهَا فَهِيَ امْرَأَتُهُ، وَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا فَوَاحِدَةٌ وَهُوَ أَمْلَكُ بِهَا» وَإِنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ رضي الله عنه قَالَ فِيهَا: «إِنِ اخْتَارَتْ زَوْجَهَا فَهِيَ امْرَأَتُهُ، وَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا فَهِيَ ثَلَاثٌ»
records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim from Umar ibn al-Khattab and Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, that they said regarding the woman given the choice: "If she chooses her husband, she remains his wife, and if she chooses herself, it is one irrevocable divorce, and he retains the right to take her back." Zaid ibn Thabit, ؓ, said regarding her: "If she chooses her husband, she remains his wife, and if she chooses herself, it is three divorces."
records.display_text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، وَابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا فِي اخْتَارِي: «إِنِ اخْتَارَتْ زَوْجَهَا فَهِيَ امْرَأَتُهُ، وَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا فَوَاحِدَةٌ وَهُوَ أَمْلَكُ بِهَا» وَإِنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ رضي الله عنه قَالَ فِيهَا: «إِنِ اخْتَارَتْ زَوْجَهَا فَهِيَ امْرَأَتُهُ، وَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا فَهِيَ ثَلَاثٌ»

records.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Umar ibn al-Khattab and Ibn Masʿud, ؓ, who said regarding the wife’s option to choose:

records.boundary_review_note: The report gives a joint statement of Umar and Ibn Masud, followed by a separately attributed statement from Zayd ibn Thabit.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that he said regarding "your choice" and "the matter is in your hands": they are the same.
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ " قَالَ فِي اخْتَارِي، وَأَمْرِكِ بِيَدِكِ: سَوَاءٌ "
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ " قَالَ فِي اخْتَارِي، وَأَمْرِكِ بِيَدِكِ: سَوَاءٌ "
records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that he said regarding "your choice" and "the matter is in your hands": they are the same.

records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ " قَالَ فِي اخْتَارِي، وَأَمْرِكِ بِيَدِكِ: سَوَاءٌ "

records.matn_en: that he said regarding "your choice" and "the matter is in your hands": they are the same.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Haytham, from someone who reported to him from Ibn Masʿud, ؓ, who said: about a man telling his wife, “Observe your waiting period”: “That counts as one revocable divorce.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي قَوْلِ الرَّجُلِ لِامْرَأَتِهِ: اعْتَدِّي ، قَالَ «وَاحِدَةً يَمْلِكُ الرَّجْعَةَ»
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي قَوْلِ الرَّجُلِ لِامْرَأَتِهِ: اعْتَدِّي ، قَالَ «وَاحِدَةً يَمْلِكُ الرَّجْعَةَ»
records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from someone who reported to him from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, that he said regarding a man telling his wife, "Observe your waiting period": "It counts as one divorce in which he retains the right to revoke."
records.display_text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي قَوْلِ الرَّجُلِ لِامْرَأَتِهِ: اعْتَدِّي ، قَالَ «وَاحِدَةً يَمْلِكُ الرَّجْعَةَ»
records.display_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Haytham, from someone who reported to him from Ibn Masʿud, ؓ, who said: about a man telling his wife, “Observe your waiting period”: “That counts as one revocable divorce.”

records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي قَوْلِ الرَّجُلِ لِامْرَأَتِهِ: اعْتَدِّي ، قَالَ «وَاحِدَةً يَمْلِكُ الرَّجْعَةَ»
records.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Haytham, from someone who reported to him from Ibn Masʿud, ؓ, who said:

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Jabir ibn Zayd, who said: “If a woman is given the choice and leaves her seat before choosing, that has no effect.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا خُيِّرَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ نَفْسَهَا فَقَامَتْ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَخْتَارَ فَلَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ»
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا خُيِّرَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ نَفْسَهَا فَقَامَتْ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَخْتَارَ فَلَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ»
records.raw_text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Amr ibn Dinar from Jabir ibn Zayd that he said When a woman is given the choice and she stands up from her seat before choosing, it is nothing.
records.display_text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا خُيِّرَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ نَفْسَهَا فَقَامَتْ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَخْتَارَ فَلَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ»
records.display_text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Jabir ibn Zayd, who said: “If a woman is given the choice and leaves her seat before choosing, that has no effect.”

records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا خُيِّرَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ نَفْسَهَا فَقَامَتْ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَخْتَارَ فَلَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ»
records.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Jabir ibn Zayd, who said:

records.boundary_review_note: Jabir ibn Zayd’s statement begins matn.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said regarding a man whose enslaved wife is emancipated before he has consummated the marriage, and she then chooses to separate: “She is not entitled to a dowry, because the separation was initiated by her.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ تُعْتَقُ امْرَأَتُهُ وَهِيَ أَمَةٌ وَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا فَتَخْتَارُ نَفْسَهَا أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لَا مَهْرَ لَهَا؛ لِأَنَّ الْفُرْقَةَ جَاءَتْ مِنْ قِبَلِهَا»
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ تُعْتَقُ امْرَأَتُهُ وَهِيَ أَمَةٌ وَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا فَتَخْتَارُ نَفْسَهَا أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لَا مَهْرَ لَهَا؛ لِأَنَّ الْفُرْقَةَ جَاءَتْ مِنْ قِبَلِهَا»
records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said regarding a man whose wife is set free while she is a slave and he has not consummated the marriage, and she chooses herself: He said, "She is not entitled to a dowry because the separation came from her side."
records.display_text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ تُعْتَقُ امْرَأَتُهُ وَهِيَ أَمَةٌ وَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا فَتَخْتَارُ نَفْسَهَا أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لَا مَهْرَ لَهَا؛ لِأَنَّ الْفُرْقَةَ جَاءَتْ مِنْ قِبَلِهَا»
records.display_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said regarding a man whose enslaved wife is emancipated before he has consummated the marriage, and she then chooses to separate: “She is not entitled to a dowry, because the separation was initiated by her.”
records.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ تُعْتَقُ امْرَأَتُهُ وَهِيَ أَمَةٌ وَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا فَتَخْتَارُ نَفْسَهَا أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لَا مَهْرَ لَهَا؛ لِأَنَّ الْفُرْقَةَ جَاءَتْ مِنْ قِبَلِهَا»
records.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
records.matn_en: that he said regarding a man whose enslaved wife is emancipated before he has consummated the marriage, and she then chooses to separate: “She is not entitled to a dowry, because the separation was initiated by her.”
records.boundary_review_note: Ibrahim’s ruling concerning the freed wife begins matn.

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Aisha, ؓ, that the Prophet, ﷺ, said to her: “Buy Barirah and emancipate her, for the right of walāʾ (the bond of manumission-based clientage) belongs to the one who emancipates.” So she bought and emancipated her, and Barirah was given the choice. Her husband was a client of the family of Abu Ahmad.
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهَا: «اشْتَرِي بَرِيرَةَ فَأَعْتِقِيهَا؛ فَإِنَّ الْوَلَاءَ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ» ، فَاشْتَرَتْهَا فَأَعْتَقَتْهَا، فَخُيِّرَتْ وَكَانَ زَوْجُهَا مَوْلَى لِآلِ أَبِي أَحْمَدَ

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim and Amr ibn Dinar, from Jabir ibn Zayd, who both said regarding the option: “If she gets up from her seat before choosing, she forfeits the right to choose.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا فِي الْخِيَارِ: «إِذَا قَامَتْ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَخْتَارَ فَلَيْسَ لَهَا خِيَارٌ»

records.boundary_review_note: Joint statement of Ibrahim and Amr ibn Dinar transmitted through Jabir ibn Zayd begins matn.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said regarding the impotent man: “He is given a respite of one year. If he is able to have intercourse with her during that time, then the matter is resolved. Otherwise, his wife is given the choice: if she wishes, she may stay with her husband, and if she wishes, she may choose herself. If she chooses herself, it is one irrevocable divorce.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْعِنِّينِ: «يُؤَجَّلُ سَنَةً، فَإِنْ خَلَصَ إِلَيْهَا، وَإِلَّا خُيِّرَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ، فَإِنْ شَاءَتْ أَقَامَتْ مَعَ زَوْجِهَا، وَإِنْ شَاءَتِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا، فَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا فَهِيَ وَاحِدَةٌ بَائِنَةٌ»
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْعِنِّينِ: «يُؤَجَّلُ سَنَةً، فَإِنْ خَلَصَ إِلَيْهَا، وَإِلَّا خُيِّرَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ، فَإِنْ شَاءَتْ أَقَامَتْ مَعَ زَوْجِهَا، وَإِنْ شَاءَتِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا، فَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا فَهِيَ وَاحِدَةٌ بَائِنَةٌ»

If she chooses herself, then it is an irrevocable divorce."

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said regarding the slave woman: When she is manumitted, she is given the choice. If she chooses herself and her husband has not consummated the marriage with her, then she is not entitled to a dowry. But if she chooses her husband and he has consummated the marriage with her, then the dowry belongs to her master.
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْأَمَةِ: «إِذَا أُعْتِقَتْ خُيِّرَتْ، فَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ زَوْجُهَا دَخَلَ بِهَا فَلَا مَهْرَ لَهَا، وَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ زَوْجَهَا وَقَدْ دَخَلَ بِهَا فَالْمَهْرُ لِسَيِّدِهَا»
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْأَمَةِ: «إِذَا أُعْتِقَتْ خُيِّرَتْ، فَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ زَوْجُهَا دَخَلَ بِهَا فَلَا مَهْرَ لَهَا، وَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ زَوْجَهَا وَقَدْ دَخَلَ بِهَا فَالْمَهْرُ لِسَيِّدِهَا»

records.text_en: Yusuf said, and Abu Yusuf said: Isma'il ibn Muslim reported to us from al-Hasan al-Basri, from Umar ibn al-Khattab, ؓ, that he said regarding the impotent man: “He is given a respite of one year. If he has intercourse with her during that time, the marriage continues; otherwise, they are separated and she is entitled to the full dowry. This is one irrevocable divorce.” Abu Hanifah also related something similar from Umar.

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, regarding the saying of God the Exalted: *"Do not evict them from their houses, nor should they leave, unless they commit an obvious immorality"* (At-Talaq: 1), he said "Her leaving her house during her waiting period is the obvious immorality."
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي قَوْلِ اللهِ تَعَالَى {لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنْ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَأْتِينَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُبَيِّنَةٍ} [الطلاق: 1] قَالَ: «خُرُوجُهَا مِنْ بَيْتِهَا فِي عِدَّتِهَا هِيَ الْفَاحِشَةُ الْمُبَيِّنَةُ»

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that Ibn Masʿud, ؓ, sent back the widows from the hinterland of al-Najaf; they had set out as pilgrims during their waiting period.
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه «رَدَّ الْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهُنَّ أَزْوَاجُهُنَّ مِنْ ظَهْرِ النَّجَفِ، كُنَّ خَرَجْنَ حُجَّاجًا فِي عِدَّتِهِنَّ»

records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, said "The wives of the deceased were sent back from the back of Al-Najaf; they had gone out as pilgrims during their waiting period."

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that a divorced woman must not leave her home for any reason until her waiting period ends. A widow may leave only for an unavoidable necessity, and must not spend the night away from her home.
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: «أَنَّ الْمُطَلَّقَةَ لَا تَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْتِهَا فِي حَقٍّ وَلَا فِي غَيْرِهِ حَتَّى تَنْقَضِيَ عِدَّتُهَا، وَالْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا لَا تَخْرُجُ إِلَّا فِي حَقٍّ لَابُدَّ مِنْهُ وَلَا تَبِيتُ عَنْ بَيْتِهَا»
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: «أَنَّ الْمُطَلَّقَةَ لَا تَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْتِهَا فِي حَقٍّ وَلَا فِي غَيْرِهِ حَتَّى تَنْقَضِيَ عِدَّتُهَا، وَالْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا لَا تَخْرُجُ إِلَّا فِي حَقٍّ لَابُدَّ مِنْهُ وَلَا تَبِيتُ عَنْ بَيْتِهَا»
records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that a divorced woman should not leave her house for any right or otherwise until her waiting period is complete, and a woman whose husband has died should not leave except for an unavoidable right, nor should she spend the night away from her house.

records.text_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said regarding a woman divorced three times and a widow: “She may apply kohl only to treat an eye ailment.”

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said regarding the waiting period of a free divorced woman: three menstrual cycles. If she does not menstruate, then three months. If she is a divorced slave woman, her waiting period is two menstrual cycles. If she does not menstruate, then one and a half months.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, that he said: “The verse, ‘The term of those who are pregnant is until they give birth,’ was revealed later than the ruling of four months and ten days.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ " نَزَلَتْ {وَأُولَاتُ الْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ} [الطلاق: 4] " بَعْدَ {أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا} [البقرة: 234] "
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ " نَزَلَتْ {وَأُولَاتُ الْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ} [الطلاق: 4] " بَعْدَ {أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا} [البقرة: 234] "
records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, that he said "The verse *And those who are pregnant, their waiting period is until they give birth* was revealed after *Four months and ten days*."
records.display_text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ " نَزَلَتْ {وَأُولَاتُ الْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ} [الطلاق: 4] " بَعْدَ {أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا} [البقرة: 234] "

records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ " نَزَلَتْ {وَأُولَاتُ الْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ} [الطلاق: 4] " بَعْدَ {أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا} [البقرة: 234] "

records.matn_en: that he said: “The verse, ‘The term of those who are pregnant is until they give birth,’ was revealed later than the ruling of four months and ten days.”

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, that he said: “The shorter Surah al-Nisa—Surat al-Talaq—abrogated all waiting-period rulings: ‘As for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth.’”
records.text_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ «نَسَخَتْ سُورَةُ النِّسَاءِ الْقُصْرَى كُلَّ عِدَّةٍ» {وَأُولَاتُ الْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ} [الطلاق: 4]

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said When a woman marries during her waiting period and her husband consummates the marriage with her, they are separated, she completes the waiting period of the first husband, and then observes a new waiting period from the other.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said regarding a miscarriage: “If some of the fetus’s features have become distinguishable, the slave woman is emancipated, and her waiting period ends with the miscarriage.”

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad: Subayʿah bint al-Harith al-Aslamiyyah, ؓ, was pregnant when her husband died. She remained for twenty-five nights or so, then gave birth. Abu al-Sanabil passed by while she was looking forward to marriage and said, “No, by the Lord of the Kaʿbah, you must wait out the longer of the two periods.” She went to the Prophet, ﷺ, and told him. He said, “Abu al-Sanabil was mistaken. When that time comes, let me know”—meaning, “when you receive a marriage proposal.”

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that he said regarding a female slave whose husband dies: if she observes her waiting period and is then emancipated during it, she continues with the waiting period prescribed for a slave woman. If she is divorced twice and then emancipated, she observes the slave woman’s waiting period. But if she is divorced once and is emancipated during her menstrual period, she observes the waiting period prescribed for a free woman.
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْأَمَةِ إِذَا تُوُفِّيَ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا فَاعْتَدَّتْ ثُمَّ أُعْتِقَتْ فِي عِدَّتِهَا: «اعْتَدَّتْ عِدَّةَ الْأَمَةِ كَمَا هِيَ، فَإِذَا طُلِّقَتْ تَطْلِيقَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ أُعْتِقَتِ اعْتَدَّتْ عِدَّةَ الْأَمَةِ، وَإِنْ طُلِّقَتْ وَاحِدَةً ثُمَّ أُعْتِقَتْ فِي حَيْضِهَا اعْتَدَّتْ عِدَّةَ الْحُرَّةِ»

If menstruation resumes afterward, she completes the waiting period by counting the menstrual periods that have elapsed.”

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said regarding a divorced woman and a widow: “The divorced woman observes her waiting period from the day her husband divorces her, and the widow from the day her husband dies.”

records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said regarding the divorced woman and the one whose husband has died: "She begins her waiting period from the day he died and from the day her husband divorced her."

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that he said regarding a woman divorced once who adorns herself and beautifies for her husband: Perhaps he may take her back, but he may not enter upon her except with permission.
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي " الْمُطَلَّقَةِ وَاحِدَةً تُشَوَّفُ لِزَوْجِهَا وَتُزَيَّنُ لَهُ: لَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يُرَاجِعَهَا وَلَا يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهَا إِلَّا بِإِذْنٍ "

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that Umar, ؓ, said: “The later-revealed of the two verses is the one in the shorter Surah al-Nisa (Surat al-Talaq).”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ «آخِرُ الْآيَتَيْنِ نُزُولًا الَّتِي فِي سُورَةِ النِّسَاءِ الْقُصْرَى»

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from the Prophet, ﷺ, that he said to Sawdah bint Zamʿah, ؓ: “Observe your waiting period.” She sat in his path and pleaded with him, invoking God’s name, to take her back. She said, “By God, I have no desire for men; I only wish to be resurrected among your wives. Give my day to Aisha.” The Messenger of God, ﷺ, did so.
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِسَوْدَةَ ابْنَةِ زَمْعَةَ رضي الله عنها: «اعْتَدِّي» ، فَقَعَدَتْ لَهُ فِي الطَّرِيقِ، فَسَأَلَتْهُ بِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ أَنْ يُرَاجِعَهَا، فَقَالَتْ: وَاللَّهِ مَابِي حِرْصٌ عَلَى الرِّجَالِ، وَلَكِنِّي أُحِبُّ أَنْ أُحْشَرَ مَعَ أَزْوَاجِكَ وَاجْعَلْ يَوْمِي لِعَائِشَةَ، فَفَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَلِكَ

records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from the Prophet, ﷺ, that he said to Sawdah bint Zam'ah, ؓ: "Observe your waiting period." records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said regarding a man with four wives who divorces one of them: “He must not marry another woman until her waiting period ends.” Abu Hanifah said: “We do not follow Ibrahim’s view about breastfeeding; rather, what is forbidden through breastfeeding is what is forbidden through lineage.” Abu Yusuf said about the waiting period of an umm walad: “He may marry her sister during her waiting period, because it is not a marital waiting period; but he may not have intercourse with her while her sister is still observing a waiting period from him.”

records.raw_text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said regarding a man who has four wives and divorces one of them: "He may not marry until her waiting period is complete." Abu Hanifah said: "We do not adopt Ibrahim's opinion on breastfeeding, but what is prohibited through breastfeeding is the same as what is prohibited through lineage." Abu Yusuf said regarding the waiting period of a mother of a child: "He may marry her sister during her waiting period, for her waiting period is not the waiting period of marriage, but he may not consummate the marriage as long as her sister is in her waiting period from him."

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu Ishaq from Shurayh that he said When four months have passed, she is irrevocably divorced by the oath of abstention.

records.text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that ʿAbd Allah ibn Unays swore to abstain from his wife, then went away and returned after five months and had intercourse with her. He then went out to his companions, his head dripping wet. They asked, “Have you been with so-and-so?” He said, “Yes.” They asked, “Had you not sworn to abstain from her?” He replied, “Yes.” They said, “We think she has become separated from you.” So they went to ʿAlqamah, but he had no ruling for them on the matter. ʿAlqamah then took them to ʿAbd Allah ibn Masʿud, ؓ. They told him what had happened to the man and his wife. He said, “Tell her that she is now separated from you, and propose to her.” He did so and gave her several mithqals of silver as her dowry.

records.raw_text_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that Abdullah ibn Unays had sworn to abstain from his wife, then he traveled and returned after five months and had intercourse with her. Then he went out to his companions while his head was dripping. They said , "Have you been with so-and-so?" He said, "Yes." They said, "Did you not swear to abstain from her?" He said, "Yes." They said, "We think she is now separated from you." So they went to Alqamah but found no ruling from him on this matter. Then Alqamah took them to Abdullah (ibn Mas'ud), ؓ. They mentioned to him the matter of Abdullah ibn Unays and his wife. He said, "Inform her that she is separated from you, then propose to her again." So he did, and he gave her silver coins as her dowry.

records.boundary_review_note: Ibrahim transmits the narrative about Abdullah ibn Unays and the consultation with Ibn Masud; the named participants are not added as links in Ibrahim’s isnad.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu Hind, that Abu al-Zubayr took an oath of abstention from his wife. After four months, he was asked, "Will you return to her or resolve to divorce?" He said , "I will return."
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هِنْدَ، أَنَّ أَبَا الزُّبَيْرِ آلَى مِنَ امْرَأَتِهِ، فَوَقَفَ بَعْدَ أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ: أَتَفِيءُ أَوْ تَعْزِمُ الطَّلَاقَ؟ قَالَ «أَفِيءُ»

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said: “The īlāʾ period for a slave woman is two months.”

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Amir that he said When a man swears to abstain from his wife and then divorces her, or divorces her and then swears to abstain from her, whichever of the two comes first takes effect in both cases.

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Amr ibn Murrah, from Abu Ubaydah, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, regarding a man who swore an oath to abstain from his wife and left her until the four months passed: "She is separated from him by one divorce, and she begins a new waiting period after the four months. He may propose to her during the waiting period, but no one else may propose to her."
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه فِي رَجُلٍ آلَى مِنَ امْرَأَتِهِ فَتَرَكَهَا حَتَّى انْقَضَتِ الْأَرْبَعَةُ، قَالَ «بَانَتْ مِنْهُ بِتَطْلِيقَةٍ وَاسْتَأْنَفَتِ الْعِدَّةَ بَعْدَ الْأَرْبَعَةِ، وَيَخْطُبُهَا فِي الْعِدَّةِ وَلَا يَخْطُبُهَا غَيْرُهُ»

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Hakam, from Miqsam, from Ibn Abbas, ؓ, that he said: “The husband’s return from īlāʾ is intercourse; his decision to divorce comes when the four months expire.”
records.text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّهُ قَالَ «الْفَيْءُ الْجِمَاعُ، وَعَزِيمَةُ الطَّلَاقِ انْقِضَاءُ الْأَرْبَعَةِ»
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّهُ قَالَ «الْفَيْءُ الْجِمَاعُ، وَعَزِيمَةُ الطَّلَاقِ انْقِضَاءُ الْأَرْبَعَةِ»
records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Hakam, from Miqsam, from Ibn Abbas, ؓ, that he said "Al-Fay’ is intercourse, and the decisive divorce is the completion of the four."
records.display_text_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّهُ قَالَ «الْفَيْءُ الْجِمَاعُ، وَعَزِيمَةُ الطَّلَاقِ انْقِضَاءُ الْأَرْبَعَةِ»

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said: “Women have no authority to initiate īlāʾ, ẓihār, or divorce.”

records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ ⦗ص: 150⦘ قَالَ «لَيْسَ إِلَى النِّسَاءِ مِنَ الْإِيلَاءِ وَلَا الظِّهَارِ وَلَا الطَّلَاقِ شَيْءٌ»
records.raw_text_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said "Women have no part in *īlāʾ*, *ẓihār*, or divorce."

records.text_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he used to say: "Divorce nullifies the oath of abstention (ila)." Abu Hanifah said "The statement of Amir is more preferable to me."
records.text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «يَهْدِمُ الطَّلَاقُ الْإِيلَاءَ» وَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ: قَوْلُ عَامِرٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ
records.raw_text_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «يَهْدِمُ الطَّلَاقُ الْإِيلَاءَ» وَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ: قَوْلُ عَامِرٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ
